note: Deal screen for product type 22A / transaction type 100. The subscreen path segments (sub1200_SUBSCREEN_*) are part of the id and change with the product type's screen layout - re-discover for any other product type.

amount.label: Amount
amount.note: SAP reformats on entry: 100000 reads back as 100,000.00. set_field_verified() compares digits, not text.

paymentCurrency.label: Payment Currency
paymentCurrency.note: Defaults to INR for product type 22A and is not changeable. Asserted, never set.

nominalInterestRate.label: Percentage Rate
nominalInterestRate.note: SAP renders 10 as 10.0000000. Present only while Interest Cat. is Fixed - switching to Variable REMOVES this field from the screen and replaces it with referenceInterestRate / interestMarkup / firstPeriodRate. A variable-rate case must not address it.

interestCategory.label: Interest Cat.
interestCategory.discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-015 model-driven run
interestCategory.note: Defaults to Fixed (key 1). Selecting Variable (key 2) REBUILDS the whole interest block on the next Enter: nominalInterestRate disappears, referenceInterestRate appears and is mandatory, and interestFrequency goes read-only until it is filled. Drive it by key, then Enter, then re-address the block.

referenceInterestRate.label: Ref. Int. Rate
referenceInterestRate.discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-015 model-driven run
referenceInterestRate.note: Only present when interestCategory is Variable, and MANDATORY there - an empty value fails Enter with hard error T1 183 'Enter a reference interest rate'. RBI_REPO is the code confirmed on DS4 for the 1000/22A profile (chosen by the requester from this field's own F4 list of 16 codes). It is a data decision, not a discoverable default.

interestFrequency.label: Frequency
interestFrequency.discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-015 model-driven run
interestFrequency.note: Defaults to At End of Term (key 1). Reads changeable=false immediately after interestCategory is switched to Variable and stays that way until referenceInterestRate is filled and accepted - fill the reference rate FIRST or this select silently has nothing to act on.

frequencyCount.label: Every
frequencyCount.discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-015 model-driven run
frequencyCount.note: Appears once interestFrequency is Monthly, pre-filled with 1. Read, not set, unless a case wants something other than every month.

frequencyUnit.label: Every (unit)
frequencyUnit.discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-015 model-driven run
frequencyUnit.note: Derived from interestFrequency - reads Months and changeable=false when the frequency is Monthly. Asserted, never set.

interestMarkup.discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-015 model-driven run
interestMarkup.note: Variable-only spread over the reference rate. Not mandatory: left blank it saves and reads back 0.0000000 (confirmed live 2026-08-19, deal 160279). A blank is therefore a real choice of zero spread, not an unset field.

firstPeriodRate.label: 1st Int. Rate
firstPeriodRate.discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-015 model-driven run
firstPeriodRate.note: Variable-only override for the first interest period. Same as interestMarkup: blank saves and reads back 0.0000000.

interestCalcMethod.label: Int.Calc.Method
interestCalcMethod.discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-015 model-driven run
interestCalcMethod.note: Defaults to act/365 for 22A and is left alone. Recorded because setting a Variable reference rate raises warning W T1 129 'No interest calculation method entered for reference interest rate' EVEN THOUGH this field shows act/365 - the warning is about the reference rate's own configuration, not this field, and is non-blocking (confirmed: deal 160279 saved through it).

contractDate.label: Contract Date
contractDate.note: Defaults to today. Must be <= Term Start or SAP refuses the save.

generalValuationClass.label: Gen. Valn Class
generalValuationClass.note: On the Administr. tab, NOT the Structure tab. A required dropdown driven by its visible label (Short Term), never by a code. This is a DIFFERENT field from TPM44/TPM1's 'Valuation Class' selection filter (0005) - setting one does not satisfy the other.

conditions.label: Conditions
conditions.note: App toolbar (Shift+F6) on the deal Structure screen. Opens the Overview of Conditions grid (see ftr-interest-conditions.json) for the interest structure just built — reachable before the deal is ever saved. Discovered live DS4/100, 2026-08-24, while building TC-022 (a second, later-dated interest condition on the Fixed 'Nominal interest' structure).

administration.label: Administr.
administration.note: SAP refuses this tab switch while a required Structure-tab field is empty - the click silently stays put and shows 'Enter the start of term'. Fill Structure first. That refusal is also why a successful switch is indirect evidence the Structure fields were accepted.
